id.description: The persistent identifier of the consent

status.description: The current status of the consent

parties.description: The non-end user parties participating in the Consent Grant

createdTime.description: When the consent was initially granted

expirationTime.description: When the consent grant will become expired

updatedTime.description: When the consent grant was updated

durationType.description: The type of duration of the consent

durationPeriod.description: The consent duration in days from day of original grant

lookbackPeriod.description: Period, in days, for which historical data may be requested; measured from request time, not grant time

autoConnect.description: Truist flag for whether to automatically extend this consent to a customer account which was newly opened or became newly visible in online banking

ConsentDurationPeriod.title: Consent Duration Period
ConsentDurationPeriod.description: Consent duration, in days, from day of original grant

ConsentDurationType.title: Consent Duration Type
ConsentDurationType.description: Duration of the Consent Grant, per FDX UX Guidelines v1.0 (pp 18 - 20)

ConsentGrantParty.title: Consent Grant Party entity
ConsentGrantParty.description: Details on the non-end user parties in the Consent Grant. Includes the legal entity operating branded products or services in the data sharing chain. Descriptive information is collected during Data Recipient registration at Data Provider, and populated during issuance by Data Provider from its registry

resourceType.description: Type of resource to be permissioned

resourceId.description: Identifier of resource to be permissioned

dataClusters.description: Names of clusters of data elements permissioned

ConsentResourceType.title: Consent Resource Type
ConsentResourceType.description: Resource for which data may be permissioned; can be extended to support additional types of resources

LookbackPeriod.title: Lookback Period
LookbackPeriod.description: Period, in days, for which historical data may be requested; period is measured from request time, not grant time

Party.title: Party entity
Party.description: FDX Participant - an entity or person that is a part of a FDX API transaction

type.description: Extensible string enum identifying the type of the party

homeUri.description: URI for party, where an end user could learn more about the company or application involved in the data sharing chain

logoUri.description: URI for a logo asset to be displayed to the end user

registry.description: The Truist registry containing the party's registration with name and id: PRIVATE

PartyType.title: Party Type
PartyType.description: Identifies the type of a party

Registry.title: Registry
Registry.description: Identifies the type of a Registry

Timestamp.title: Timestamp
Timestamp.description: ISO 8601 date-time in format 'YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss.nnn[Z|[+|-]hh:mm]' according to [IETF RFC 3339](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc3339.html#section-5.6)
